# Getting started

Install the CLI with the package manager you already use, then log in once.

## First upload

The first upload creates a bucket automatically. Run the upload command with a file
path and the CLI prints the bucket name and a shareable link. Uploads are resumable,
so a dropped connection does not start from zero.

## Regions and quotas

Buckets live in one region: us-east, eu-west or ap-south. Choose the region closest to
your users. Each workspace starts with 100 GB of storage; the quota resets only when
you delete data, never monthly.

## Support

Support answers within one business day. Include the bucket name and the request id
from the failing command.
